positions.commentary: The speaker considers Amazon a great example of a well-managed company where investors should not have sold based on the thesis that AWS would be a major profit driver.

thesis: This episode argues that Amazon is a well-managed company where investors should not have sold based on the thesis that AWS would be a major profit driver.

claims.claim: The speaker considers Amazon a great example of a well-managed company where investors should not have sold based on the thesis that AWS would be a major profit driver.
claims.quote: I think the best example here probably is Amazon, right? I doubt anyone in 2002 invested in Amazon's thinking that AWS was going to be the largest profit driver, especially because it didn't exist. And then if you thought that that changed your thesis, then you would have made a terrible mistake in selling Amazon.
